name: get_market_cap_rates
description: Look up prevailing going-in and exit cap-rate benchmarks for a market and property type. Use this to ground a deal’s exit cap rate assumption in market context. Returns SYNTHETIC reference data (demo dataset, not real market quotes).

name: get_comparable_sales
description: Return recent comparable sales (address, sale price, NOI, cap rate, date) for a market and property type, to sanity-check a deal against the market. Returns SYNTHETIC comps (demo dataset, not real sales).

limit.description: Max number of comps to return (1–3). Defaults to 3.
